214	// mirrorCreateOutcome bundles the create response with the clone status
215	// observed while waiting. polled is false for --no-wait and for empty upstreams,
216	// where there is nothing to await; in those cases status is unset.
217	type mirrorCreateOutcome struct {
218		created *coreapi.CreatedMirror
219		status  coreapi.MirrorStatus
220		polled  bool
221	}
222	
223	// createAndAwaitMirror is the single create-then-wait path shared by the
224	// `repo mirror create <github-url>` one-shot and the onboarding wizard, so both
225	// report identical lifecycle states. It registers the GitHub mirror on
226	// clusterHost (idempotent on (upstream, cluster)) and, unless noWait or the
227	// upstream is empty, polls the control plane until the clone reaches a terminal
228	// status. The returned error is the create error (when outcome.created is nil)
229	// or the wait error — a status sentinel (errMirrorCloneFailed /
230	// errMirrorSuspended) or a timeout; callers read outcome.status for the state.
231	//
232	// onCreated (may be nil) fires once the placement is registered, before any
233	// clone polling — it separates the fast "placing" phase from the slow "cloning"
234	// wait so callers can render them as distinct steps.
235	func createAndAwaitMirror(ctx context.Context, c *coreapi.Client, owner, repo, clusterHost string, noWait bool, timeout time.Duration, onCreated func(*coreapi.CreatedMirror), onStatus func(coreapi.MirrorStatus)) (mirrorCreateOutcome, error) {
236		created, err := c.CreateMirror(ctx, &coreapi.CreateMirrorInputBody{
237			Provider:    coreapi.CreateMirrorInputBodyProviderGithub,
238			Owner:       owner,
239			Repo:        repo,
240			ClusterHost: clusterHost,
241		})
242		if err != nil {
243			return mirrorCreateOutcome{}, err
244		}
245		if onCreated != nil {
246			onCreated(created)
247		}
248		outcome := mirrorCreateOutcome{created: created}
249		if created.Empty {
250			// An empty upstream has nothing to clone, so don't poll for "ready" — it
251			// never would. But an *existing* placement can be suspended even when
252			// empty, and one status read surfaces that (a fresh create can't be
253			// suspended — suspension follows upstream access loss). Mirrors the old
254			// finishMirrorCreate behavior; the read is best-effort, so a transient
255			// GetMirror error just falls through to the benign "nothing to clone".
256			if !created.Created {
257				if m, gerr := c.GetMirror(ctx, coreapi.GetMirrorParams{MirrorId: created.MirrorId}); gerr == nil {
258					if s, ok := m.Status.Get(); ok && s == coreapi.MirrorStatusSuspended {
259						outcome.status = s
260						outcome.polled = true
261						return outcome, errMirrorSuspended
262					}
263				}
264			}
265			return outcome, nil
266		}
267		if noWait {
268			return outcome, nil
269		}
270		status, werr := awaitMirrorReady(ctx, c, created.MirrorId, timeout, onStatus)
271		outcome.status = status
272		outcome.polled = true
273		return outcome, werr
274	}
275	
276	// reportOneShotMirror renders the human output for `repo mirror create
277	// <github-url>` from the shared createAndAwaitMirror result. A nil
278	// outcome.created means CreateMirror itself failed — surface that error (nothing
279	// was printed yet). Otherwise echo the placement, then the lifecycle outcome.
